name: 01-general
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium Arabic social-media advertisement for LamsaTap, portrait 4:5 composition, ideally 1536 x 1920 pixels. This is one of a cohesive three-ad campaign. Use impeccably shaped, fully legible Arabic with correct connected letters, natural RTL layout and polished bold contemporary Arabic typography similar to Readex Pro. Warm ivory #FAF7F2, very dark green-black #14201F, subtle sand and tiny restrained gold accents. Photorealistic hospitality product photography, editorial luxury rather than a generic template. Strong typographic hierarchy, generous margins, 3 distinct visual zones: brand/headline upper, beautiful real product scene middle, offer/contact lower. No gradients, no neon, no excessive boxes, no fake testimonials, no fake badges, no watermark, no random text. Reference icon image is the exact approved four-part square/pinwheel LamsaTap mark: reproduce its geometry faithfully and pair with the word LAMSATAP, not any other logo. Existing photo is a reference for the real brand and product/materials; compose it professionally into the advertisement. Show a discreet small "صورة توضيحية" next to the product photo. Website and phone must be exact, clearly legible, placed on their own LTR lines to avoid reversed digits: LAMSATAP.COM and 0507250396. All text must be part of the finished poster, not a mockup on a wall.
GENERAL BRAND AD. Transform the two hospitality reference photographs into one coherent high-end campaign composition. A tangible transparent acrylic LamsaTap tabletop stand in the foreground, a modern smartphone hovering close to it as a natural NFC interaction, coffee and a subtle warm apartment doorway in the depth. Keep the physical stand exact and convincingly photographed, not a floating abstract shape. The phone has a clean understated digital menu interface, only tiny graphic rows, no fake readable claims. Center the whole composition with deliberate whitespace. Use the following exact Arabic copy only:
Main headline in two large lines: "لمسة واحدة." / "تجربة أذكى."
Supporting line: "حلول NFC وQR للمطاعم والكافيهات والإيجار القصير"
Three short service phrases: "منيو إلكتروني" / "تقييم قوقل" / "دليل الضيف"
Prominent closing statement: "العتاد والتركيب علينا طوال الاشتراك"
CTA: "خلّنا نجهّز تجربتك"
Contact label: "تواصل واتساب"
Website: "LAMSATAP.COM"
Phone: "0507250396"
Tiny image note: "صورة توضيحية"
This general ad has NO prices and no tax statement. Maintain a luxurious calm product-launch feel with an instantly readable headline and recognizable products.
